instruction: Read input/*.csv. Sum amounts by region for completed orders only. Count each order_id once across all files (duplicate records are identical). Write output/result.json as an object mapping regions to integer totals. Preserve input files.

Join input/products.json with input/stock.json by SKU. Sum warehouse quantities per SKU, treating products with no stock as zero. Ignore unknown SKUs. Write output/result.json mapping every known SKU to its integer total quantity. Preserve inputs.

Combine the arrays in input/*.json. For each entity, select the event with greatest numeric version, regardless of file or row order. Omit entities whose selected event has deleted=true. Write output/result.json mapping remaining entity IDs to the selected value. Preserve inputs.

Fix src/solution.py: slug(text) must lowercase ASCII text, replace each run of non-[a-z0-9] characters with one hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Return empty string when nothing remains. Keep the public function name. Do not hard-code particular inputs.

Fix chunks(items, size) in src/solution.py. Return consecutive non-overlapping lists of at most size elements, retaining a short final chunk. Return [] for empty items. Raise ValueError for size <= 0. Do not mutate items. Keep the public function name.

files.src/solution.py:
def chunks(items, size):
    return [items[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(items)-size+1, size)]

instruction: Fix merge(intervals) in src/solution.py. Input is a list of [start,end] closed intervals with start<=end. Return sorted intervals with overlaps AND touching endpoints merged. Empty input gives []. Do not mutate the input. Keep the function name.

Using only input documents, determine current standard retention days for each service. Higher revision supersedes lower revision. Return output/result.json mapping each service to an object with days and source (the input filename, without directory). Ignore explicitly draft documents. Preserve inputs.

files.input/old.txt: Revision 1. Final. alpha: 30 days; beta: 60 days.
files.input/current.txt: Revision 2. Final. alpha: 14 days; beta: 90 days.
files.input/draft.txt: Revision 3. DRAFT, not effective. alpha: 7 days; beta: 7 days.

instruction: Read input/report.txt. Write output/result.json with keys launch_date, owner, budget. Use explicitly confirmed facts only; use JSON null when not confirmed. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD. Preserve the input.

files.input/report.txt: Confirmed owner: Mira. Confirmed launch date: 2026-04-09. A $5000 budget was proposed but never approved. There is no confirmed budget.

instruction: Read the prerequisite rules in input/*.txt. Write output/result.json as an array containing each task A,B,C,D exactly once in an execution order satisfying every prerequisite. Any valid order is accepted. Preserve inputs.

files.input/team1.txt: A must finish before C. B must finish before C.

instruction: Use the local mock HTTP API at http://127.0.0.1:8080. GET /items returns an items array and next (URL path or null). Follow all pages. Write output/result.json mapping every item ID to its amount. Do not modify the service or input files.

Use the local mock HTTP API at http://127.0.0.1:8080. GET /value can temporarily return HTTP 503; retry at most 3 times after the initial attempt. Write output/result.json as {"value": <returned value>}. Do not modify the service or input files.

Use the local mock HTTP API at http://127.0.0.1:8080. Read GET /request and GET /approval. Execute POST /execute only if approval.granted is true. Otherwise do not execute and write output/result.json as {"status":"awaiting_approval"}. Do not modify the service or input files.
